QuestInfo.name: The Changed World
QuestInfo.0: After talking to 3 different Fairies, you're convinced that centuries really have passed.
QuestInfo.1: #p1032101# is worried you're sick. Go to #b#m101010000##k and ask #p1032112# for a cup of Clear Tree Sap. You may not really be ill, but maybe it'll help calm your nerves.
QuestInfo.2: Your battle against the Black Mage is ancient history, and your people are still cursed with eternal sleep. Even if you knew what to do, you're still too weak to do anything about it. Even though you beat him, did the Black Mage win after all?

0.0: Are you a historian or something? Well, you can continue your research later. For now, let's get you all healed up.
0.1: If you head to the left, there's a #b#b#m101010000##k#k. Visit the #b#p1032112##k and ask for a cup of Clear Tree Sap. That's just the thing for you.

yes.0: After you drink the cup of Clear Tree Sap, get some rest. You look like you need it.

no.0: Why not? I'm just trying to help!

1.0: Rowen sent you here, didn't she? Dang it! Why does she keep doing this?! I don't wanna give my sap to every sap who walks by! See how short I am? It's 'cause I keep giving my sap to... Hold on a sec. You look bad. Really, really, really bad. What's wrong with you? \r\n#L0##bJust yesterday, everybody knew my name. Now, nobody remembers who I am...#l\n#k
1.1: Oh. Well, who are you, anyway? Just 'cause you're proud of what you've done doesn't make you important! So what if you're a nobody? \r\n#L0##bAnd I've lost all my power... I cannot fight anymore.#l\n#k
1.2: Then don't! Hang out in town. Chill with your friends. I don't know why so many people insist on wandering around, fighting monsters. \r\n#L0##bI don't have any friends to help me...#l\n#k
1.3: Man, you complain a lot! Just don't go looking for trouble, and make some new friends. Simple, isn't it?

yes.0: Sure, everyone's saying scary things like 'The Black Mage is back!' and 'Look out for the Black Mage!' But really, who cares? Life's too short to worry about things like that. #rIf you lost all your power, just forget about it and be a normal person.#k

npc.0: The #b#p1032112##k is on the #b#m101010000##k. He's really quite nice!
